entities.summary: Low intensity asymmetrical conflict between the agriculturalist lendu and pastoralist hema ethnic groups in the ituri region of the north-eastern dr congo; subconflict of second congo war (main phase 1999–2003; started in 1972, continues to present) Took place in Ituri Province. Date: 1999. Ended: 2003.
